Benoit Favre In this paper, we propose to apply the method proposed in [8] for automatically mapping word embeddings across languages and use them to translate sentiment lexicons only given a small, general bilingual dictionary. After creating monolingual word embeddings in the source and target lan- guage, we train a linear transform on the bilingual dictionary and apply that transform to words for which we don’t have a translation.
